params.subtitle: A sandbox for trying out in-place editing

/post/second/.title: A second post
/post/second/.content: Another post to edit, so that the list of posts has more than one, and so that an edit held on one post can be seen from another. Edits not yet committed are kept in your browser, and shown on the page until committed or discarded.

/post/hello/.title: Hello from the review site
/post/hello/.content:
This post exists to be edited. Click the “Edit in Infusion” button in your browser’s toolbar, choose Edit this page, and change anything you like - this paragraph, the heading below, or the list.

Things to try

  • Change a word of this list, or add an item to it
  • Make some text bold or italic, or add a link
  • Unfold Edit as source in the panel to see your edit as markdown

Committing

Press Commit in the panel. The extension shows you the change in a window of its own, and once you confirm it, commits it to this site’s repository. The site is rebuilt in a minute or two, and the panel then shows your edit as published.
